headline: Clean your space without trashing the planet
body: Ditch ugly jugs for sleek bottles that look right at home on your counter. Refillable, plant-based cleaning that matches your aesthetic and keeps plastic out of our oceans.
rationale: This copy targets The Gen Z Aesthete by focusing on visual appeal and counter presentation rather than dry corporate utility. It uses a playful, identity-expressive tone that fits their desire for values-aligned home goods while avoiding performance-heavy jargon.
